subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should normal runtime auth-store loads be allowed to import legacy secret-bearing `auth-profiles.json`, or must this recovery stay in doctor/update/startup migration code?
rationale: The report is a real upgrade regression, but the PR changes a credential and migration boundary that current tests, docs, and repository policy keep out of steady-state runtime reads.

options.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
options.body: Rework the fix into doctor/update/startup migration or warning code and preserve the current runtime invariant.

options.title: Approve Runtime Import
options.body: Accept the runtime fallback deliberately, then update the invariant test, docs, and security expectations around retired credential JSON.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Leave this PR paused or close it after a narrower canonical fix is selected under the broader auth migration issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
recommendation.body: Rework the fix into doctor/update/startup migration or warning code and preserve the current runtime invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to Peter as the heaviest contributor to the auth persistence boundary and persisted auth helpers involved in this decision.
